applicability: Failing closed when joint geometry cannot support a valid state estimate
Distinguishing unavailable joint channels from measured zero
claim: In the exact certified L2.7 same-epoch synthetic perturbation grid around a 5 mm anchor tolerance, 0 and 2.5 mm cases remain valid with available dependent joint channels, while 7.5 and 20 mm cases return ANCHOR_MISMATCH and JOINT_GEOMETRY_UNAVAILABLE, with null or unavailable dependent channels and zero motor torque, passive torque, and command count.

evidence.certification_claim_boundary: This campaign can certify only the exact L2.0-L2.7 joint-actuator observations named by the source-pinned programs. Fixed scaffolds, free roots, actuator envelopes, hard-limit reactions, two-joint behavior, and anchor-observer failures retain their declared fixture scopes. It establishes no contact-bearing articulated limb, per-foot or per-contact load allocation, standing, bracing, fall arrest, getting up, gait, walking, accepted knowledge, or automatic creature guidance.

program.claim_scope: The joint observer accepts anchor mismatches only within the declared tolerance and fails closed with zero commands when geometry is mismatched or unavailable.

failure_boundaries: The perturbations are synthetic and do not measure physical joint strength or damage
Observer refusal performs no repair and authorizes no command
No load bearing, standing, bracing, recovery, gait, or walking is established
mechanism: The observer first validates joint-anchor agreement. Outside tolerance it refuses joint geometry and every dependent state channel instead of substituting a numeric zero or permitting a command from invalid state.
scope: Only the exact synthetic 0, 2.5, 7.5, and 20 mm anchor-error cells, same-epoch body observations, 5 mm tolerance, and program claim scope certified by br4_20260723T090118Z_1760c2cf.
title: The joint observer exposes small anchor mismatch and fails closed beyond tolerance
